help_outline FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Enterprise Clarity & Governance

Straight answers to common questions about deployment, data protection, and our delivery model.

We deploy zero-data-retention (ZDR) enterprise endpoints and private on-premise or VPC vector databases (pgvector / Qdrant). Your contracts, financials, and client records never leave your designated perimeter and are strictly excluded from public model training datasets.
We integrate with all major ERPs, CRMs, and communication tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Xero, QuickBooks, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and WhatsApp Business API through robust n8n and Make webhook pipelines.
A focused pilot workflow is typically architected, tested, and deployed into staging within 2 to 4 weeks. Full enterprise multi-agent rollouts with staff upskilling bootcamps span 6 to 8 weeks.

No. Through our Build + Train model, we upskill your non-technical team and project managers with the hands-on capability to operate daily workflows independently, eliminating rigid engineering dependencies.

To protect your operations post-launch, we provide:

  • Limited Time Post-Deployment Support: Hands-on bug fixing, prompt refinement, and system stabilization right after go-live.
  • Optional Monthly Maintenance Care: Regular workflow health checks, API updates, and priority troubleshooting so your systems scale smoothly as your business grows.
